name: dev-dashboard
description: Docked pane that keeps the live state of a session in view: the Jira issue the branch names, what is running now, the signals that need action, test/type/lint results, uncommitted changes, the branch's sync and PR checks.

jira.title: Show the branch's Jira issue
jira.description: Reads the issue whose key (NX-123) the branch or worktree name carries, through the Atlassian connector: summary, status, parent, assignee and the description's checklist.

jiraSite.title: Jira site
jiraSite.description: Cloud id or site URL (xxx.atlassian.net). Empty: the first site the Atlassian connector can read Jira on, looked up once and remembered.

commits.title: Commits shown
commits.description: How many recent commits the pane lists.

autoOpen.title: Open at session start
autoOpen.description: Open the pane by itself when the terminal is fullscreen and wide enough. /dashboard opens it at any width.

band.title: Draw the usage band above the prompt
band.description: Rate limits with their reset and pace, context fill and what it grew by, and the session's cost, in one row on the terminal. It takes the place of another plugin's band there (usage-bar); off, that band shows again.

pollSeconds.title: Git poll interval (seconds)
pollSeconds.description: How often the git facts are re-read while the session idles, for commits made outside the session. 0 turns polling off.

pr.title: Show the branch's pull request
pr.description: Reads the current branch's PR, its checks and review state with gh. Off, gh is never run.

prSeconds.title: PR poll interval (seconds)
prSeconds.description: How often gh is asked again while the session runs; a git push or gh pr command also asks. 0 turns polling off.

protectedBranches.title: Shared branches
protectedBranches.description: Comma-separated branch names (* matches any text). Uncommitted changes or local commits on one of them raise a signal.

recapLines.title: Recap lines
recapLines.description: How many lines of the previous session's last answer the pane keeps.

theme.title: Pane colors
theme.description: auto follows Claude Code's theme setting; light and dark force a palette.
